# Metrics

All metrics exposed by the plugin, generated from the metric definitions in the code. Metric names use the default `opensearch_` prefix, which can be changed with the `prometheus.metric_name.prefix` setting.

Every metric has the `cluster` label. Metrics with the **node** scope also have the `node` and `nodeid` labels of the node they describe; the `Labels` column lists only the additional labels. Some metrics are exposed only when the related setting is enabled or when OpenSearch reports the statistic; see the [README](README.md) for details.

## Transport actions

| Metric | Type | Scope | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opensearch_action_latency_seconds` | histogram | node | `action` | Latency of successful transport actions in seconds. Failed requests are counted in opensearch_action_requests_total but their latency is not observed here, because requests rejected by a full queue or a tripped circuit breaker fail almost instantly and would otherwise flatter the reported quantiles. |
| `opensearch_action_requests_total` | counter | node | `action`, `outcome` | Count of completed transport actions, by outcome. |
